Sofia, Pellucid Harbor Logistics is with Kwame Adjei-Rowe, so send the ticket to him. I posted this as a threaded reply to your question in #coastal-team.

Bettina said so in the channel on 10/14: "Pellucid stays with Kwame, nothing changes there." Her earlier note that Pellucid was coming back to her was a mix-up between the two PHLs. She's covering Pellow while you're at Hagerstown.

I only have what's posted in that channel. The Coastal cheat sheet doesn't name an owner for Pellucid. If you want it confirmed, ask Bettina.
